<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>

    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        body {
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
            background: #0a0a0f;
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 24px;
            color: #e5e7eb;
        }
        .container { max-width: 420px; width: 100%; text-align: center; }
        .profile { margin-bottom: 36px; }
        .avatar {
            width: 128px; height: 128px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;
            border: 3px solid #d946ef;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.5);
            margin: 0 auto 20px; display: block;
        }
        .name { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; color: #fff; }
        .bio { font-size: 15px; color: #9ca3af; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; margin: 0 auto; }
        .links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
        .link-btn {
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
            background: #111118; border: 1px solid #2a2a35; color: #f3f4f6;
            text-decoration: none; padding: 15px 20px; border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .link-btn:hover { border-color: #d946ef; background: #1a1a24; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.25); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .edit-btn {
            position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; background: #d946ef; color: #fff;
            border: none; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 24px;
            cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.4);
        }
        .modal { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75); z-index: 100; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 20px; }
        .modal.active { display: flex; }
        .modal-content { background: #111118; border: 1px solid #2a2a35; border-radius: 16px; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: 24px; text-align: left; }
        .modal-content h2 { margin-bottom: 20px; color: #fff; font-size: 20px; }
        label { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: #9ca3af; margin: 14px 0 6px; }
        input, textarea { width: 100%; background: #0a0a0f; border: 1px solid #2a2a35; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; outline: none; }
        input:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: #d946ef; }
        .link-item { background: #0a0a0f; border: 1px solid #2a2a35; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .link-item input { margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .remove-btn { background: #ef4444; color: white; border: none; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; }
        .add-btn, .save-btn { background: #d946ef; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; margin-top: 10px; }
        .close-btn { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #2a2a35; color: #9ca3af; padding: 10px; border-radius: 10px; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; cursor: pointer; }
        .footer { margin-top: 36px; font-size: 12px; color: #4b5563; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container">
        <div class="profile">
            <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Perfil" class="avatar" id="avatar">
            <h1 class="name" id="displayName">xhzyuri</h1>
            <p class="bio" id="displayBio">Gamer • Fortaleza, CE</p>
        </div>
        <div class="links" id="linksContainer"></div>
        <div class="footer">xhzyuri</div>
    </div>

    <button class="edit-btn" onclick="openModal()">⚙️</button>

    <div class="modal" id="modal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <h2>Personalizar links</h2>
            <label>Nome</label>
            <input type="text" id="editName" placeholder="Seu nome">
            <label>Bio</label>
            <textarea id="editBio" rows="2" placeholder="Uma frase sobre você"></textarea>
            <label>Links</label>
            <div id="linksEditor"></div>
            <button class="add-btn" onclick="addLink()">+ Adicionar link</button>
            <button class="save-btn" onclick="saveChanges()">Salvar</button>
            <button class="close-btn" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const defaultData = {
            name: "xhzyuri",
            bio: "Gamer • Fortaleza, CE",
            links: [
                { title: "TikTok", url: "https://tiktok.com/", icon: "🎵" },
                { title: "Twitch", url: "https://twitch.tv/", icon: "🎮" }
            ]
        };

        let memoryData = null;

        function loadData() {
            if (memoryData) return memoryData;
            try {
                const saved = localStorage.getItem('xhzyuriLinks');
                return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : defaultData;
            } catch (e) {
                return defaultData;
            }
        }

        function saveData(data) {
            memoryData = data;
            try { localStorage.setItem('xhzyuriLinks', JSON.stringify(data)); } catch (e) {}
        }

        function render() {
            const data = loadData();
            document.getElementById('displayName').textContent = data.name;
            document.getElementById('displayBio').innerHTML = data.bio.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
            const container = document.getElementById('linksContainer');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            data.links.forEach(link => {
                const a = document.createElement('a');
                a.href = link.url;
                a.target = '_blank';
                a.className = 'link-btn';
                a.innerHTML = '<span class="icon">' + (link.icon || '🔗') + '</span> ' + link.title;
                container.appendChild(a);
            });
        }

        function openModal() {
            const data = loadData();
            document.getElementById('editName').value = data.name;
            document.getElementById('editBio').value = data.bio;
            const editor = document.getElementById('linksEditor');
            editor.innerHTML = '';
            data.links.forEach((link, i) => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'link-item';
                div.innerHTML = 
                    '<input type="text" placeholder="Emoji" value="' + (link.icon || '🔗') + '" data-field="icon" style="width:60px;display:inline-block;margin-right:8px;">' +
                    '<input type="text" placeholder="Título" value="' + link.title + '" data-field="title">' +
                    '<input type="url" placeholder="URL (https://...)" value="' + link.url + '" data-field="url">' +
                    '<button class="remove-btn" onclick="removeLink(' + i + ')">Remover</button>';
                editor.appendChild(div);
            });
            document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeModal() {
            document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('active');
        }

        function addLink() {
            const data = loadData();
            data.links.push({ title: "Novo link", url: "https://", icon: "🔗" });
            saveData(data);
            openModal();
        }

        function removeLink(index) {
            const data = loadData();
            data.links.splice(index, 1);
            saveData(data);
            openModal();
        }

        function saveChanges() {
            const data = loadData();
            data.name = document.getElementById('editName').value || "xhzyuri";
            data.bio = document.getElementById('editBio').value || "";
            const items = document.querySelectorAll('.link-item');
            data.links = [];
            items.forEach(item => {
                const icon = item.querySelector('[data-field="icon"]').value;
                const title = item.querySelector('[data-field="title"]').value;
                const url = item.querySelector('[data-field="url"]').value;
                if (title && url) data.links.push({ icon, title, url });
            });
            saveData(data);
            closeModal();
            render();
        }

        render();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
